quotes.text: I got a taxi from Piura to Mancora in Peru once, a 3hr drive, and when I said where I wanted to go the taxi driver did a victory lap around the taxi rank high fiving all the other drivers. $60 I think + tip.

All this winning.  With that said the coastal communities in Ecuador used to be cool but the last ten or fifteen years absolutely have turned into a cartel hot zone.  

You don’t want to travel past mancora in Peru or you’re in drug war central

We did part of that from Lima up to Mancora and back. 16 hours each way. Surprisingly comfy seats considering, though they insisted on showing absolutely terrible Kirk Cameron Christian films on the little telly.

When you forget your pastel paper and you just have a little Plein Air Fun with watercolor paper and Rembrandts on a beautiful beach in Mancora, Peru.🇵🇪
